getStarted.title: Get started with AI agents
getStarted.description: Hand off tasks to autonomous AI agents that iterate until the job is done. Run them locally, in the background, or in the cloud, with your choice of AI provider. Track all sessions without leaving VS Code.

featured.title: Set up VS Code
featured.description: Install VS Code, open your code, and choose a guided path for your first task.

featured.title: Learn VS Code basics
featured.description: Explore the editor, settings, extensions, source control, running, and debugging.

featured.title: Complete a task with an AI agent
featured.description: Build and validate a small web app with an AI agent, then review the generated changes.

featured.title: Add language support
featured.description: Set up editing, running, and debugging for Python, JavaScript, C++, and more.

featured.title: Customize AI for your project
featured.description: Configure custom instructions, skills, and MCP servers to tailor AI to your workflow.

featured.title: VS Code for enterprise
featured.description: Learn how to configure VS Code for enterprise environments with policies, extension management, and AI customization options.

latest.title: VS Code 1.139 release
latest.description: Run agents in remote Dev Containers, manage sessions with faster, more compact lists, and edit with word wrap indicators and smarter bracket auto-closing.

latest.title: Agent harness concepts

latest.title: Introducing the Agent Host
latest.description: Learn how the VS Code Agent Host and Agent Host Protocol (AHP) enable persistent, portable agent sessions across windows, clients, and local or remote environments.
